title: Version
description: llama.cpp release version

title: Backend
description: Hardware backend for llama.cpp (CUDA, HIP/ROCm, Vulkan, CPU, etc.)

title: Environmental variables
description: Environmental variables for llama.cpp(KEY=VALUE), separated by ';'

title: Check for updates
description: Fetch the remote llama.cpp release list. Required for the version dropdown to show releases beyond what's installed locally, and for update notifications.

title: Auto update engine
description: Automatically download and switch to the latest llamacpp engine when available. Requires "Check for updates" to be on.

title: Verify backend dependencies
description: Check that GPU backend shared libraries (CUDA, Vulkan, etc.) resolve on startup and warn if any are missing.

title: Max Concurrently Loaded Models
description: Maximum number of models the router will keep loaded at once. 0 = unlimited.

title: Timeout for llamacpp
description: Llamacpp connection and load timeout in seconds

title: Kuru Fit
description: Automatically place layers and size context from measured memory on every load. Turn off to restore stock Jan fitting (llama.cpp fit) and show all original settings.

title: Fit (auto-adjust to device memory)
description: Whether to adjust unset arguments to fit in device memory ('on' or 'off'). (env: LLAMA_ARG_FIT)

title: Fit Target per Device (MiB)
description: Target margin per device for fit, comma-separated list of MiB values. Single value is broadcast across all devices. (env: LLAMA_ARG_FIT_TARGET)

title: Fit Minimum Context Size
description: Minimum context size (tokens) that can be set by the auto-fit option.

title: Threads
description: CPU threads for generation. -1 uses all logical cores. Speed only — memory planning ignores it.

title: Threads (Batch)
description: CPU threads for prompt processing. Defaults to the Threads value. Speed only.

title: Context Shift
description: When the window fills, drop the oldest tokens and keep generating instead of erroring.

title: Max Tokens to Predict
description: Longest single reply in tokens. -1 means unlimited. Does not affect memory planning.

title: uBatch Size
description: Physical maximum batch size for processing prompts.

title: Devices for Offload
description: Comma-separated list of devices to use for offloading (e.g., 'CUDA0', 'CUDA0,CUDA1'). Leave empty to use default/CPU only.

title: GPU Split Mode
description: How to split the model across multiple GPUs.

title: Main GPU Index
description: The GPU to use for the model (split-mode=none) or intermediate results (split-mode=row).

title: Flash Attention
description: Faster attention kernels using less memory. Auto lets llama.cpp decide; a per-model override lives in each model’s own settings, and changing it re-measures calibrated models.

title: Parallel Sequences
description: Number of parallel slots for your own chat requests (0 = llama.cpp default of 4). Jan reserves one additional internal slot for background requests (e.g. thread auto-titling), so they don’t evict your chat’s KV cache. Changing it re-measures calibrated models.

title: Continuous Batching
description: Enable continuous batching (a.k.a dynamic batching) for concurrent requests.

title: Disable mmap
description: Load the whole model file into RAM instead of mapping it. Much higher RAM use — only for network drives or debugging.

title: MLock
description: Force system to keep model in RAM, preventing swapping/compression. Can fail loads that would otherwise limp along on swap.

title: KV Cache K Type
description: KV cache data type for Keys (default: f16).

title: KV Cache V Type
description: KV cache data type for Values (default: f16).

title: RoPE Scaling Method
description: How position info stretches past trained length. Only for running beyond a model’s native context.

title: RoPE Scale Factor
description: Stretch factor: 2 doubles usable context, with quality cost.

title: RoPE Frequency Base
description: Advanced: base frequency override. 0 keeps the model’s own.

title: RoPE Frequency Scale Factor
description: Advanced: fine-tunes the scaled frequencies. Rarely needed.

title: Prompt Cache RAM (MiB)
description: Host-RAM cap for saved prompt caches (idle conversations kept warm). Not counted by the context planner — lower it on tight machines.

title: Cache Reuse
description: Reuse cached KV for shared chunks of at least this many tokens. 0 = off. Try 256 for faster follow-ups; costs no extra memory.

title: Full SWA Cache
description: Use full-size KV cache for sliding-window-attention models (e.g. Gemma). Enable this if such a model reprocesses the entire prompt every turn instead of reusing cache; costs more memory.

title: Unified KV Cache
description: One KV cache shared across parallel slots, so each slot sees the full context. Forcing it off splits the context per slot.

title: Keep First N Tokens
description: Number of tokens from the initial prompt to keep when context is shifted. -1 = keep all.
